scanNote: 18-mashq audio (kasseta) bilan bajariladi. Audio yo'q, shuning uchun javoblar e'lonlar matni, rasmlar va shu unitdagi 4-mashq matnlari bilan taqqoslab mantiqan chiqarilgan — har birining sababi whyUz da yozilgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu ikki e'lon 18-mashqning asosi. Avval ularni to'liq o'qing —
keyin mashqlarni bajarish oson bo'ladi.

E'LON TILI qisqa bo'ladi: fe'l va artikl tushib qoladi.
  To'liq: 'This is a lovely house. It is five miles from the city centre.'
  E'londa: 'Lovely house five miles from city centre'

Yulduzcha (*) — ro'yxat belgisi. Nuqta-vergul (;) xonalarni ajratadi.

sentences.uz: Ijaraga beriladi — oyiga 800 funt. Sandon ko'chasi, 6-uy.
sentences.noteUz: Birinchi e'lon — UY (house). Qimmat: oyiga 800 funt.

sentences.en: Lovely house five miles from city centre
sentences.uz: Shahar markazidan besh mil masofadagi go'zal uy
sentences.noteUz: 5 mil ≈ 8 km. Markazdan uzoqroq, lekin katta.

sentences.uz: Tepa qavatda — 4 yotoqxona; 2 hammom (vanna, dush, hojatxona)
sentences.noteUz: 'Upstairs' — tepa qavat. Katta oila uchun mos.

sentences.en: Downstairs — spacious living-room; kitchen; dining-room; study; small bathroom
sentences.uz: Past qavatda — keng mehmonxona; oshxona; ovqatlanish xonasi; ish xonasi; kichik hammom
sentences.noteUz: Past qavatda 5 ta xona. Jami 11 ta xona.

sentences.uz: Ijaraga beriladi — oyiga 300 funt. ARZON!! Chamberlain ko'chasi, 8-uy.
sentences.noteUz: Ikkinchi e'lon — KVARTIRA (flat). 'Bargain' — juda arzon narx, foydali taklif.

sentences.en: 2 bedrooms; 1 large bathroom (bath, shower, toilet); modern kitchen; comfortable living-room; dining-room
sentences.uz: 2 yotoqxona; 1 katta hammom (vanna, dush, hojatxona); zamonaviy oshxona; qulay mehmonxona; ovqatlanish xonasi
sentences.noteUz: Jami 6 ta xona. Kichik oila uchun yetarli.
Kvartirada ham bog' va garaj bor — bu yaxshi taklif.

exercises.instructionEn: Karen and Tom want to rent a house or flat. Look at the pictures, then listen to the cassette and say which place they want.
exercises.instructionUz: Karen va Tom uy yoki kvartira ijaraga olmoqchi. Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng kassetani tinglab, ular qaysi joyni tanlaganini ayting.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada Karen va Tom suhbatlashadi. Audio yo'q — javob e'lonlardagi ma'lumot va narxga qarab mantiqan berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
TANLASH MEZONLARI — qaysi e'lon kimga mos:

  6, Sandon Street — UY
    + juda katta (11 xona), katta bog', ikki mashinalik garaj
    − qimmat (£800), markazdan 5 mil uzoq
    → katta oila va mashinasi bor odamlar uchun

  8, Chamberlain Street — KVARTIRA
    + arzon (£300, BARGAIN), markazga yaqin
    − kichikroq (6 xona), bog'i kichik
    → yosh juftlik yoki kichik oila uchun

Karen va Tom — juftlik, ya'ni ikki kishi. Ularga 4 ta yotoqxona
kerak emas va £800 ko'p pul.

items.textEn: Which place do Karen and Tom want?
items.uz: Karen va Tom qaysi joyni tanlaydi?
items.whyUz: Ular ikki kishi: 2 yotoqxonali kvartira yetarli, narxi uch baravar arzon (£300) va shahar markaziga yaqin. Uydagi 4 yotoqxona va £800 ularga ortiqcha.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisements, then listen again and underline the correct word in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: E'lonlarni o'qing, so'ng qayta tinglab, qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'zni tanlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada javoblar tasdiqlanadi. Audio yo'q — har bir javob e'lon matni, rasm va 4-mashqdagi shunga o'xshash matnlar bilan solishtirib chiqarilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
Oltita bo'shliq: 1–3 UY e'lonida, 4–6 KVARTIRA e'lonida.

Har birida ikkita so'zdan biri to'g'ri. Qaror qilishda:
  • rasmga qarang (bog' bormi? basseyn bormi?)
  • narxga qarang (£800 qimmat uy, £300 arzon kvartira)
  • mantiqqa qarang (kichik bog'da basseyn bo'lmaydi)

items.whyUz: Uy juda katta va qimmat (£800). Mashqning namuna matni ham 'it is very large' deydi. Katta uyning mehmonxonasi keng bo'ladi.

items.uz: Uyning past qavatida yana qaysi kichik xona bor?
items.whyUz: Tepa qavatda 4 yotoqxona bor, past qavatda yotoqxona kerak emas. 4-mashqdagi shunga o'xshash uy matnida ham: 'Downstairs, there is a small bathroom'.
Rasmda oq panjarali uy va o't-o'lan ko'rinadi, basseyn yo'q. 'large garden' — katta bog'.
Rasmda ko'p qavatli g'ishtli bino — bu kvartira. Chalet esa tog'dagi yog'och uy, shahar markazida bo'lmaydi.
Kvartira 2 yotoqxonali oila uyi — unda ovqatlanish xonasi bo'ladi. 'Study' (ish xonasi) katta uyning belgisi, u birinchi e'londa sanab o'tilgan.
Bog'i KICHIK — kichik bog'da basseyn sig'maydi. Arzon kvartirada basseyn bo'lishi ham mantiqsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Now, using the advertisements, describe the two places. Start like this: This lovely house is five miles from the city centre. It is very expensive, but it is very large. Upstairs, there are ...
exercises.instructionUz: Endi e'lonlardan foydalanib, ikkala joyni tasvirlab bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LONDAN TO'LIQ GAPGA.

E'londa fe'l va artikl yo'q, siz ularni QAYTA TIKLAYSIZ:
  E'lon:  'Lovely house five miles from city centre'
  To'liq: 'This lovely house is five miles from the city centre.'

Kerakli tuzilmalar:
  There is / There are — xonalarni sanash
  It is + sifat        — baho berish
  It has got           — egalik
  Upstairs / Downstairs — qavatlar

Kitob boshlab bergan: 'This lovely house is five miles from the
city centre. It is very expensive, but it is very large. Upstairs,
there are ...' — davomini o'zingiz yozasiz.

structure.modelEn: This lovely house is five miles from the city centre.
It is very expensive, but it is very large.
Upstairs, there are four bedrooms and two bathrooms with a bath, a shower and a toilet.
Downstairs, there is a spacious living-room, a kitchen, a dining-room, a study and a small bathroom.
Outside, it has got a large garden and a double garage.
It is at 6, Sandon Street and it is £800 per month.
This attractive flat is near the city centre.
It is very cheap — it is only £300 per month.
There are two bedrooms, one large bathroom with a bath, a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen, a comfortable living-room and a dining-room.
Outside, there is a small garden and a garage.
It is at 8, Chamberlain Street.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap 1 ochko. Ko'p ochko olgan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 3 ning eng muhim 17 ta so'zi. Har biri bilan gap tuzing.

QOIDA: gap MA'NOLI va TO'G'RI bo'lishi kerak. So'zni shunchaki
ishlatish yetarli emas — u gapga mos kelishi shart.

Quyida har bir so'z uchun namuna gap berilgan. Avval o'zingiz
urinib ko'ring, keyin namunani tekshiring.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Look at the picture of the house on p. 18 for one minute, then close your books and say what there is in each room. Each correct answer gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. 18-betdagi uy rasmiga bir daqiqa qarang, so'ng kitobni yopib, har bir xonada nima borligini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
XOTIRA O'YINI — 18-betdagi uy rasmi bo'yicha.

QADAMLAR:
  1) 18-betni oching va rasmga BIR DAQIQA qarang
  2) kitobni yoping
  3) har bir xonada nima borligini eslab ayting

Bu o'yin lug'atni MAHKAM o'rnashtiradi: rasm ko'rgach, so'z
tarjima orqali emas, narsaning o'zi orqali esga tushadi.

Quyida har bir xona uchun to'liq javob berilgan — o'zingiz
aytib bo'lgandan keyin tekshiring.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in Ex. 18 to write two short advertisements (50-80 words each) similar to those in Ex. 4. Use the pictures from the Photo File section and the plan below.
exercises.instructionUz: 18-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib, 4-mashqdagiga o'xshash ikkita qisqa e'lon yozing (har biri 50–80 so'z).
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LON YOZISH REJASI (kitobdagi Plan):

  For Rent: ................
  Address:  ................
  - type of place  — uy turi (house / flat)
  - where          — qayerda
  - cost           — narxi
  - size           — hajmi
  - inside         — ichkarisi (xonalar, mebel)
  - outside        — tashqarisi

DIQQAT — 4-mashqdagi e'lonlar TO'LIQ GAP bilan yozilgan
(18-mashqdagi qisqa e'londan farqli):
  4-mashq: 'This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre.'
  18-mashq: 'Lovely house five miles from city centre'

Siz TO'LIQ GAP bilan yozasiz — ya'ni 4-mashq uslubida.
50–80 so'z — taxminan 6–8 ta gap.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchala maqol ham BITTA fikrni aytadi: uy — eng qadrli joy.

Har bir tilda shunday maqollar bor. O'zbekchada:
  'Har kimning o'z uyi — o'ziga jannat.'
  'Ona yurting — oltin beshiging.'

Maqollarni yodlash lug'atni kengaytiradi va gapirishda
nutqni jonli qiladi.

sentences.en: Home is where the heart is.
sentences.uz: Uy — qalb qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yer.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: haqiqiy uy — bino emas, siz sevgan odamlar bor joy.
Boshqa shaharda yashasangiz ham, qalbingiz oilangiz yonida bo'lsa —
o'sha yer uyingiz.

Tuzilishi: 'where' — 'qayerda' ma'nosidagi bog'lovchi.
Home is + WHERE + the heart is.

sentences.en: There is no place like home.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: dunyoda o'z uyingga teng keladigan joy yo'q.
Qanchalik chiroyli joyda bo'lmang, uyingizga qaytish yaxshi.

Tuzilishi: 'There is no ...' — bu unitning grammatikasi!
'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' emas, 'kabi, o'xshash' degani.
  no place like home = uyga o'xshash joy yo'q

MA'NOSI: qayerga borsangiz ham, o'z uyingiz eng yaxshisi.

Bu maqol QOFIYALI: west /west/ va best /best/ — shuning uchun
oson yodlanadi va ko'p ishlatiladi.

'best' — 'good' sifatining eng yuqori darajasi:
  good → better → best (yaxshi → yaxshiroq → eng yaxshi)

groups.explanationUz: E'londa joy tejash uchun artikl (a/the) va 'to be' fe'li tushib qoladi. Siz o'qiyotganda ularni tiklashingiz kerak.

items.base: Lovely house five miles from city centre
items.derived: This is a lovely house. It is five miles from the city centre.
There are two bedrooms and one large bathroom.
It has got a small garden and a garage.

groups.ruleUz: double / single — son bildiruvchi oldi qo'shimchalar
groups.explanationUz: Narsaning nechta kishi yoki nechta buyum uchun ekanini bildiradi.

items.derived: a double bed / a single bed
a double room / a single room

groups.explanationUz: Ko'p sifatlar -er va -est oladi, lekin 'good' butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.

patterns.formula: This + sifat + uy turi + is + masofa/joy.
patterns.exampleEn: This lovely house is five miles from the city centre.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan besh mil masofada.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tasvirni shu qolip bilan boshlash — Enterprise'ning standart namunasi.
Masofa uchun FROM, yaqinlik uchun NEAR.

patterns.formula: It is + sifat, BUT it is + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: It is very expensive, but it is very large.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda qimmat, lekin juda katta.
patterns.explanationUz:
'but' bilan ijobiy va salbiy tomonni bitta gapda beriladi.
Bu e'lon va tavsifda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Upstairs, there are ... Downstairs, there is ...
patterns.exampleEn: Upstairs, there are four bedrooms. Downstairs, there is a spacious living-room.
patterns.exampleUz: Tepa qavatda to'rtta yotoqxona bor. Past qavatda keng mehmonxona bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qavat so'zi gap boshida, keyin vergul.
Tavsifni tartibli qiladi: avval tepa, keyin past, oxirida tashqari.

patterns.formula: Outside, it has got ... / The house has also got ...
patterns.exampleEn: Outside, it has got a large garden and a double garage.
patterns.exampleUz: Tashqarisida katta bog' va ikki mashinalik garaj bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'also' — 'yana, shuningdek'. 'has got' dan OLDIN, 'has' dan KEYIN turadi:
  The house HAS ALSO GOT a garden.

patterns.formula: It is a bargain at only £... per month.
patterns.exampleEn: It is a bargain at only £300 per month.
patterns.exampleUz: Oyiga atigi 300 funt — bu juda arzon.
patterns.explanationUz:
'only' — 'atigi, faqat'. Narxni arzon ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.
'at' — narx oldidan keladi.
